policy: Armenia releases are public because the v1 donor artifact and target sources are public. Every per-record artifact must retain an explicit US-donor/support-stratum banner and must never be described as Armenian microdata. Builds are named by data_build_id, never ordinals, and each publishes into its own folder, releases/<release>/<build>/, which releases.json lists.

licence.name: ArmStat ILCS open dissemination (exact licence text to verify)
licence.notes: ArmStat makes ILCS household and member microdata available for free/open download. Chronicle must capture the exact licence text before a native-ILCS release; v1 itself republishes no ILCS unit record. The populace-US donor artifact's own public licence and exact certified revision must also be pinned before execution.

notes: The target dataset year is 2024. source_coverage.json follows the country-neutral populace#265 contract. validation_bands.json reports ArmStat national-accounts comparisons plus harvested CEQ/World Bank oracle bands; the latter are never gates unless promoted through Ledger. releases.json names each release's current build and the repository's default release; only the emitter's release writer changes it, and no pointer file names a build. No release or publication machinery exists in this spec-only package.
